manifest.name: Robot logistics workshop · 10/10/1/4/4 per minute

stockControl.mode: five deciders, independent chest item < cap; dynamic collector filters

setupNotes: Factorio 2.1.24 Space Age, normal quality: AM2 and chemical plants, no modules, red belts, fast and bulk inserters, substations. WEST entrances north to south: sulfuric acid (pipe), plastic, copper, iron, steel (belts), lubricant (pipe). EAST: one passive provider chest with independent caps 20 construction robots, 20 logistic robots, 2 roboports, 10 storage chests, 10 passive provider chests. All circuits, cable, gears, pipes, engines, batteries, frames and steel chests are made inside. Preserve the red ring wires (per-tile hold readers), the green chest and token wires, filters and caps. Supply electricity at any substation; the three are wired together.
Leave the shared chest unrestricted (no bar). Caps: 20 construction, 20 logistic, 2 roboports, 10 storage, 10 passive provider; they live in the five filter deciders.
The entrance panels show recipe totals at the targets. The production tokens run the products a little above target, so plan supply for the measured draw in the README, not for the panels.
Do not remove the red wires from ring tiles or the circuit conditions on the arms; the three arms on the west edge (plastic, iron, steel) are the ring entrances.

evidence.reason: Passing production and recovery evidence matches this exact import and prototype.
